# Front Row Insurance

> > Specialized insurance broker serving film production, entertainment, and special events across Canada and the United States.

Front Row Insurance Brokers Inc., led by industry veterans including Grant Patten, David Hamilton, and Alyson Locacciato, provides comprehensive coverage solutions for film productions, documentaries, weddings, festivals, and entertainment professionals. Operating from Toronto and Vancouver, the company offers specialized products including Commercial General Liability, Errors & Omissions (E&O), vehicle insurance for productions, and kidnap & ransom coverage for foreign location filming.

## Key Topics

- Film Production Insurance
- Errors & Omissions (E&O) Insurance
- Commercial General Liability
- Entertainment Insurance
- Wedding and Special Event Insurance
- Foreign Location Filming
- Kidnap and Ransom Coverage
- Production Audiovisuelle (Quebec)
- Crew and Cast Protection
- Documentary Insurance (IDA)
- Vehicle Insurance for Productions
- Entertainment Law Compliance
- Media Releases and Clearances
- Film Independent Member Benefits
- Crisis Management for Productions

- [Kidnap and Ransom Insurance: Why Film Productions Should Consider It](https://www.frontrowinsurance.com/articles/kidnap-and-ransom-insurance): K&R insurance coverage for film productions shooting in foreign locations
